title: Eradane Maduve
desc: Humiliated by his family and friends after a work suspension, a desperate Vishwanath seeks to save face through a reckless affair. His plan backfires when he discovers his wife has a similar idea.

title: Putnanja
desc: Putnanja, a poor farmer, falls in love with Roja, a city-bred woman. They get married despite opposition from her mother, but differences soon crop up between them.

title: Sachein
desc: Sachein saves Shalini's father from a life-changing accident. However, pride keeps them from revealing their love, as their friendship faces challenges that test their hearts and egos.

title: Bulbul
desc: A gangster's daughter attempts suicide after Vijay spurns her. When threatened, Vijay falsely claims to love his childhood friend, unwittingly inviting further complications.

title: Milana
desc: Anjali's father forces her to marry Akash. Unable to forget her past, she demands a divorce from Akash, but soon begins to fall for him.

title: Maaman
desc: A complex relationship unfolds between an uncle and his nephew, testing their family ties through emotional turmoil and personal conflicts.
